rule_ast.literal_policy: Every numeric AST literal references a parameter_id or declares a mathematical constant; enum literals declare enum/version.
rule_ast.hard_safety: Known FALSE rejects; otherwise required UNKNOWN yields UNKNOWN; never coerce null/unknown to pass.
rule_ast.ordered_classification: First TRUE branch; unresolved higher-priority branch that can change output yields UNKNOWN.

parameter_instance_contract.change_policy: new parameter_set_id and model_contract_id; preserve previous outcomes

missing_policy.required_input_unknown: dependent field UNKNOWN; never replace with zero/false
missing_policy.known_false_safety: reject even if another predicate UNKNOWN
missing_policy.optional_input: diagnostic quality only unless AST explicitly depends on it
missing_policy.confirmed_suspension: distinct from DATA_MISSING; skip only where a window contract allows
missing_policy.data_missing_identity_unknown_adjustment: never silently skip, carry, or impute
missing_policy.zero_denominator: UNKNOWN or NOT_APPLICABLE only as explicitly specified
missing_policy.insufficient_history: affected field UNKNOWN; report its first available date
missing_policy.capability_degradation: scope to affected dataset/field/consumer; never weaken predicate or block independent capability

TECHNICAL_BAR_WINDOW_V1.definition: For N technical bars ending at as-of t, use the latest N verified actual security bars at or before t. Confirmed local suspensions may be crossed without consuming a bar; unknown or non-suspension missing bars make dependent fields UNKNOWN.

field_map.hhv_n_llv_n: N actual high/low bars including t; every required input valid
field_map.prior_high_n_prior_low_n: N actual bars strictly before t
field_map.tr_n: N actual bars ending t plus prior verified actual close for first TR; suspension gap uses previous actual close and is annotated
field_map.atr_n: SMA of N TR values under tr_n
field_map.slope_n: declared actual-bar offset; all component windows complete
field_map.amount_volume_ratio_n: prior N actual bars before t when formula specifies prior
field_map.weekly_monthly_technical: closed periods, explicit period identity and as-of; same actual-bar missing rules

TECHNICAL_BAR_WINDOW_V1.suspended_asof: UNKNOWN if a current actual bar is required

CROSS_SECTION_SESSION_WINDOW_V1.definition: All securities share identical market-session start/end dates; endpoints never move to replace suspension or missing data.

field_map.ret_n: exact C[t]/C[t-N]-1; suspended/unavailable endpoint => UNKNOWN; intermediate confirmed suspension is annotated without moving endpoints; unexplained missing session => UNKNOWN
field_map.rps_relative_n: same-session same-window returns on PIT-evaluable universe; rank evaluable members only; count<2 => UNKNOWN; record count and coverage
field_map.vol_n: N one-session log returns require N+1 consecutive session closes; any suspension interval, missing, or nonpositive price makes full window UNKNOWN; no dropping or annualization
field_map.coverage: report per-field coverage/unknown/suspended counts; do not alter predicates

FORWARD_SESSION_WINDOW_V1.definition: T+N is the Nth subsequent master market session from frozen T0, regardless of security suspension; never extend horizon by skipping sessions.

field_map.actual_endpoint: OBSERVED only with verified endpoint and common evaluation basis
field_map.verified_suspension: separate MARKED_ESTIMATE only after quote-age/coverage gates; never relabel observed or fabricate zero return
field_map.unknown_missing_identity_adjustment_unva: UNKNOWN/unvalued; no carry, zero fill, deletion, reweight or horizon extension
field_map.path_metrics: quality-check every path date; valid endpoint does not imply complete MFE/MAE/MDD

benchmark_missing_policy.missing: no carry/zero fill/drop/reweight; retain original weights and reasons
benchmark_missing_policy.verified_suspension: MARKED_SUSPENSION only with verified basis conversion and accepted quote-age/coverage gates; report separately

consumer_permissions.MARKED_ESTIMATE: separate marked relative only; never merge with OBSERVED
consumer_permissions.PARTIAL_UNVALUED: no complete relative return; observed_contribution diagnostic; independent absolute outcomes continue

benchmark_missing_policy.gate_values: unassigned until V4-00H; marked benchmark consumers disabled until accepted

legacy_extraction_manifest.prohibition: No inferred rewrite/equivalence or V4 eligibility use before exact extraction and independent golden-vector acceptance

capability_switch.permission: SHADOW_STABLE_PASS[capability] AND FORWARD_GATE[capability] AND MIGRATION_REPLAY_PASS[capability] AND required_dependency_permissions
capability_switch.dependency_scope: per capability; failure cannot veto independent scope
capability_switch.forward_event_thresholds: candidate IDs registered only; V4-00H freezes policy
capability_switch.insufficient_samples: affected capability stays SHADOW_ONLY; extend its own observation

enum_literal_contract.resolution: enum_id and enum_version must match the contract enum_contracts declaration; value must be a declared member.
